known_constraints: Source data must exist before any transformation can occur
Column names are required to reference fields reliably
Aggregation requires numeric or countable fields
Output format must be defined before generation

common_steps.name: Locate source data
common_steps.description: Identify the tabular input (e.g., CSV, spreadsheet, table export). No assumptions about schema.

common_steps.name: Inspect structure
common_steps.description: Observe available columns, data types, and row volume.

common_steps.name: Select fields of interest
common_steps.description: Determine which columns are relevant for the intended report.

common_steps.name: Apply aggregation or transformation
common_steps.description: Summarize, group, or transform data according to an external decision.

common_steps.name: Produce output
common_steps.description: Generate a new artifact (e.g., CSV, table, sheet) reflecting the transformation.
